method: Existing registry Transcriber, local cached faster-whisper base language=en, CPU/int8, word_timestamps=True, vad_filter=True, diarize=False. One whole-file pass per reference. Sample cache reused. Offline environment; no paid call.

definitions.word_count: Lexical ASR word entries containing a letter or digit; numbers and contractions follow ASR tokenization. Window assignment uses word-interval midpoint.
definitions.elapsed_wpm: Recognized lexical word entries divided by entire editorial/window duration, times60; pauses included.
definitions.occupancy: Union of ASR word-alignment intervals divided by window duration; timing proxy, not physiological voiced fraction.
definitions.pause: Nonnegative gap between adjacent recognized word endpoints. Gaps>=0.15s tabulated; no inference that all are intentional silence.
definitions.timed_run: Successive ASR words connected by gaps<=0.35s. This is an operational timing unit, not a semantic phrase or syntactic sentence.
definitions.eligible_run_wpm: Run words divided by run elapsed span, for runs>=4words and>=1second; proxy excludes larger breaks and must not be used as a global narration-speed target.
definitions.sentence_terminal_gap: Gap after machine punctuation ending in period/question/exclamation; punctuation is not hand verified.
definitions.fixed_windows: Complete30second bins from source0; final partial bin excluded from distribution.
definitions.roles: Editorial roles informed by earlier transcript/visual review; bounds are analyst choices, not universal exact chapter/cut boundaries.

quality_flags.description: Probabilities are model estimates, not a calibrated transcript-accuracy score; segmentation and punctuation are machine generated.

main_narration_region_summary.note: Excludes pre-narration witness/music opening. Occasional other voices remain unseparated.

limits: ASR cannot establish pitch contour, emphasis, warmth, vocal identity, emotional performance, loudness hierarchy, perceived rhythm or intelligibility.
Music/SFX and non-English speech can cause missed words, hallucinations and inaccurate gaps; Nepal pre-narration0–26.533s is excluded when interpreting main narrator cadence.
Nepal includes occasional other voices; diarization disabled, so estimates describe recognized English speech, not one isolated narrator at every instant.
Named entities and numerical readings are error-prone; full transcripts remain in temporary cache and are not factual source evidence.
No audible playback, no additional paid review, no generation or canonical guide edits.
Cross-video differences are estimates from one consistent ASR route; do not claim exact artist prosody or clone identity.
short_excerpt_policy: No transcript excerpts are published in these durable files. Raw full text stays in temporary caches.
